title: Potato Dynamics 2.0 — Compositional Open-System Toy Model
authorship_warning: This model is a mathematical extension built from recovered Tim/Potato concepts. It is NOT presented as a verbatim equation authored by Tim and is NOT established fundamental physics.
goal: Turn the existing vocabulary—Axis, Door, Eye, relation, Garden, transformation, repair—into a compositional mathematical toy system that can be applied to symbolic, informational or empirical domains without silently mixing them.

components.g: geometry, metric or similarity structure appropriate to the domain
components.D: Door transition maps or guarded reset maps
components.V: viability region: states that preserve specified life/system requirements

continuous_flow.meaning: Structural flow may depend on intervention/control u and structural scale/description parameter s.

physical_time_when_applicable.rule: Use t only when a genuine temporal dynamical system is intended; do not confuse s and t by default.

door_transition.meaning: A Door can be represented as a hybrid-system transition: when a state reaches a guard/threshold, the reset map sends it into a new regime/configuration.
door_transition.timic_bridge: Needle, Gate, Door, citizenship, border, initiation and phase transition can all be represented as thresholds only after their domain-specific guard conditions are defined.

eye_observation.meaning: Eye is modeled as observation rather than omniscience. Measurements can contain noise ε and incomplete information.
eye_observation.rule: Observation updates confidence; it does not automatically establish causation or truth.

information_integration.rule: No single scalar is declared 'the' amount of spiritual integration.

boundary_open_system.abstract_form: input → [ boundary B | internal state S | dynamics A ] → output
boundary_open_system.categorical_neighbor: Structured/decorated cospans model open systems with interfaces and composition. A generic structured cospan has L(a) → x ← L(b).
boundary_open_system.timic_bridge: Door is not merely separation; it is a compositional interface through which systems remain distinct while interacting.

composition.notation: P_2∘P_1 when outputs/interface conditions of P_1 match inputs/interface conditions of P_2
composition.meaning: Complex systems are built from smaller systems by composing compatible boundaries rather than flattening everything into one node.

relationship_graph.criterion: rank(C)=n for controllability of a finite-dimensional linear time-invariant system
relationship_graph.timic_bridge: This gives 'repair' and 'Gardener' a stronger question: which nodes/relations can actually steer the system, rather than which nodes merely look central?

viability_garden.viability_kernel: Viab(V)={x_0∈V : ∃ admissible u(t) such that x(t)∈V for all required t}
viability_garden.meaning: Garden can be formalized as preserving conditions under which life/system states remain viable, rather than maximizing one quantity without constraint.
viability_garden.timic_bridge: Cultivation becomes constraint-aware control: keep the system inside a life-supporting region while enabling growth and adaptation.

red_blue_control.meaning: The polarity becomes a control tradeoff: too much preservation can freeze adaptation; too much exploration can destroy stability.
red_blue_control.warning: This is a later control-theory rendering and not a recovered Tim formula.

repair_operator.sequence: SEE → TRACE ROOTS → DISTINGUISH → DIAGNOSE INVERSION → REPAIR BRIDGES → CULTIVATE CAPABILITY → PROTECT → RECONNECT → MEASURE → RETURN
repair_operator.formal_reading: state estimation → causal diagnosis → constraint identification → intervention design → control → observation → iterative update

needle_bifurcation.interpretation: As μ changes, equilibrium structure can appear/disappear. This captures qualitative threshold change without pretending the Tim event obeyed this physical ODE.

free_energy_neighbor.fact: In variational inference, free energy bounds surprise/evidence-related quantities under specified probabilistic models.
free_energy_neighbor.timic_bridge: Eye/observer can be modeled as inference under uncertainty; action can alter observations and future trajectories.
free_energy_neighbor.caution: The free-energy principle is a scientific research framework with debate and domain assumptions; it is not evidence for divine cognition or Potatoverse metaphysics.

levels_and_frame_change.meaning: Sisyphus/change-level intuition becomes a disciplined question about representation: can a hard problem be simplified by quotienting, coarse-graining, adding state variables or changing coordinates?

model_invariants.question: What survives Door transitions or frame changes?
model_invariants.external_neighbor: Noether conservation applies only when a differentiable action has a continuous symmetry; symbolic invariants require their own definition.

empirical_modes.possible_data: nodes, typed edges, timestamps, provenance, confidence
empirical_modes.appropriate_tools: graph statistics, temporal networks, causal hypotheses, spectral analysis

empirical_modes.possible_data: entities, ownership, trade, funding, procurement, infrastructure
empirical_modes.appropriate_tools: network flows, dependency metrics, controllability/robustness, input-output analysis

empirical_modes.possible_data: bud positions, dormancy, sprouting, environmental conditions
empirical_modes.appropriate_tools: developmental biology, phyllotaxis, reaction-diffusion or growth models where justified
formal ontology, temporal graph, narrative/state-machine analysis; not particle physics by default

red_team: A mathematical model can be useful even when it is not fundamental physics.
A good analogy should increase precision and expose mismatches, not only similarities.
The same word—field, entanglement, dimension, frequency, energy—must not silently change technical meaning between domains.
Models should compete against simpler baselines.
If no observation could distinguish the model from alternatives, classify it as interpretation or formal metaphor rather than empirical theory.
